A '''skirmish on Biitu''' occurred between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the companions of the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]]. The Empire invaded [[Biitu]] to set up a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]-[[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Fuel-ore processing plant|processing plant]], and in the process imprisoned Baobab. He was rescued by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and the [[Biituian]] [[Fidge Tadrazan]], and together they defeated the Imperials.
